title: Order API 500 surge caused by database connection saturation
resolutionSummary: Reduced connection leak from a recently deployed transaction path, increased pool observability, and rolled back the slow query change.

title: Order write latency increase from lock timeout
resolutionSummary: Removed a conflicting batch update and adjusted lock acquisition order for order and inventory reservation updates.

title: Payment authorization timeout increase
resolutionSummary: Shifted eligible traffic to the secondary provider and restricted retry fan-out while verifying idempotency-key persistence.

title: Payment event backlog after provider recovery
resolutionSummary: Paused automatic replays, isolated failed authorization events, and replayed only idempotent messages after manual approval.

title: Inventory sync consumer lag and stock mismatch
resolutionSummary: Identified poison messages, moved them to the dead-letter queue, and replayed validated inventory updates in partition order.

title: SMS delivery delay caused by provider rate limit
resolutionSummary: Applied provider-specific backoff, prioritized transactional messages, and delayed non-critical campaign messages.
